def max_number_of_cuts(arr, limit):
    diff_list = []
    even_count = 1 if arr[0] % 2 == 0 else 0
    odd_count = 1 if arr[0] % 2 == 1 else 0
    cuts = 0
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        if odd_count == even_count and abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]) <= limit:
            even_count = 0
            odd_count = 0
            diff_list.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]))
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even_count += 1
        else:
            odd_count += 1
    diff_list.sort()
    for difference in diff_list:
        if limit < difference:
            break
        cuts += 1
        limit -= difference
    return cuts

def main():
    total_items = int(input())
    max_allowed = int(input())
    sequence = [int(input()) for _ in range(total_items)]
    print(max_number_of_cuts(sequence, max_allowed))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
